definition.def: Depression is a mental state in which you are sad and feel that you cannot enjoy anything, because your situation is so difficult and unpleasant.
examples: Mr Thomas was suffering from depression.
I slid into a depression and became morbidly fascinated with death.

definition.def: A depression is a time when there is very little economic activity, which causes a lot of unemployment and poverty.
examples: He never forgot the hardships he witnessed during the Great Depression of the 1930s. [+ of]

definition.def: A depression in a surface is an area which is lower than the parts surrounding it.
A depression is a mass of air that has a low pressure and that often causes rain.
